gulf-coast-owner-benchmark-2026.title: 2026 Gulf Coast owner benchmark
gulf-coast-owner-benchmark-2026.summary: Shared owner benchmark built from Seascape's Gulf Coast operating data so fee, channel, and revenue-leak pages cite the same owner-economics facts.
gulf-coast-owner-benchmark-2026.sourceLabel: 2026 Gulf Coast vacation rental market report + Seascape operating benchmark
gulf-coast-owner-benchmark-2026.methodology: Benchmark combines current Seascape operating data across five active Gulf Coast homes with owner-side fee-stack analysis. Scenario math is labelled separately from observed operating facts.

examples.title: Sarasota Luxe
examples.summary: In March 2026, Sarasota Luxe had 32.8% direct booking share and saved about $730 versus Airbnb-like drag.
examples.note: Observed March 2026 property example. Not a promise for other homes.

examples.title: Patrick portfolio
examples.summary: In March 2026, the Patrick portfolio had 5.7% direct booking share. One direct booking saved about $450 versus Airbnb.
examples.note: Observed March 2026 portfolio example. Direct booking share was real, but still limited.

examples.title: Bradenton Pool Home
examples.summary: In March 2026, Bradenton Pool Home showed 16.4% effective commission because Airbnb took a cut of a cleaning-heavy subtotal.
examples.note: Observed cost example showing why cleaning-heavy subtotals matter.
